preconditions.expression: all(t.isdigit() and 1 <= int(t) <= 10**4 for t in stdin.splitlines()[0].split())
preconditions.description: The first line contains a single integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10^4) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(x.isdigit() and 1 <= int(x) <= 2**29 for x in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each subsequent line contains a single integer x (1 ≤ x ≤ 2^29) representing the remembered value x = a ⊕ b = (a + b)/2.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout.splitlines()[i] == '-1' and not any((a.isdigit() and b.isdigit() and 0 < int(a) <= 2**32 and 0 < int(b) <= 2**32 and int(a) ^ int(b) == int(x) and (int(a) + int(b)) == 2 * int(x)) for a, b in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]] if line != '-1'])) or (stdout.splitlines()[i] != '-1' and any((a.isdigit() and b.isdigit() and 0 < int(a) <= 2**32 and 0 < int(b) <= 2**32 and int(a) ^ int(b) == int(x) and (int(a) + int(b)) == 2 * int(x)) for a, b in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]] if line != '-1')) for i, x in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: For each test case x, output either a valid pair (a, b) where a and b are positive integers ≤ 2^32 satisfying a ⊕ b = x and (a + b)/2 = x, or -1 if no such pair exists. The output must be exactly t lines, one per test case.

postconditions.expression: all((line == '-1' or (a.isdigit() and b.isdigit() and 0 < int(a) <= 2**32 and 0 < int(b) <= 2**32)) for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line is either '-1' or two space-separated positive integers a and b (0 < a, b ≤ 2^32).
